summary: Jikai Fujiyoshi was a Buddhist studies scholar who served as a professor at Rissho University and was a member at Kyoto University (attested 1967).

Jikido Takasaki was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at the University of Tokyo and completed his PhD at Savitribai Phule Pune University, later serving as professor at the University of Tokyo and president of Tsurumi Women's University.

Jim G. Shaffer is an archaeologist and Indologist. He earned his BA from Arizona State University and his PhD from the University of Wisconsin-Madison, later serving as professor of anthropology at Case Western Reserve University from around 1974.

Jim Rheingans works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He earned an MA from the University of Hamburg and a PhD from the University of the West of England/Bath Spa University, holding posts at Hamburg, Vienna, and Sydney (all attested 2026).

Jin Kyoung Choi is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. Choi studied for a doctorate and served as a postdoctoral researcher at Ghent University, and is attested as a lecturer at the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities in 2026.

Jin Y. Park specializes in philosophy and Buddhist studies. Park served as Assistant Professor of Philosophy and Religion at American University (attested 2007–2012) and was a visiting fellow at City University of Hong Kong.
Jin-il Chung is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who has served as a collaborator (attested 2008) and editor (attested 2026) at the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

Jinah Kim is a scholar of Indian and South Asian art history and Buddhist studies. After earning a PhD at UC Berkeley under Joanna Gottfried Williams, Kim held posts at Vanderbilt and Harvard, serving as professor at Harvard (attested 2026).
Jinavijaya Muni was an Indologist and historian who served as Principal of Gujarat Vidyapith and founded the Rajasthan Puratana Granthamala (attested 1959).

Jinbo Shi is a scholar of history, archaeology, linguistics, and Buddhist studies. He earned a master's at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences under Jingru Wang and later became a professor and fellow emeritus at CASS and Minzu University of China.
Jinchuan Wan is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who held professorships at National Central University and Fo Guang University (both attested 2010).
Jing Yin is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under K. L. Dhammajoti (attested 1995) and served as Director at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2006–2010).

Jing-shen Tao is a historian and sinologist. He studied at National Taiwan University and completed his PhD at Indiana University Bloomington, later serving as Professor of East Asian Studies at the University of Arizona from around 1976 to 2000.
Jingru Wang was a scholar in linguistics and history/archaeology. He studied at Tsinghua University from around 1926 to 1929 and held a post at Minzu University of China from around 1952 to 1958.
Jingyi Yang is a researcher in Indology, Tibetology, and computational studies, affiliated with the University of Hamburg as a student and research project staff member (attested 2026).

Jinhua Chen is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology. He completed graduate studies at McMaster University and postdoctoral research at Kyoto University under Noritoshi Aramaki, and later served as professor of East Asian Buddhism at the University of British Columbia.

Jinhua Jia is a scholar of Sinology, religious studies, and philosophy who earned a PhD at the University of Colorado Boulder under Paul W. Kroll. She held posts at Harvard, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, and the University of Macau.
Jinling He is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a Master of Arts at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Hiroki Okumura.
Jinping Liao is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a Master of Arts at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Kirill Solonin.

Jinshi Fan is an archaeologist and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Peking University under Su Bai. She served as Director of the Dunhuang Academy from 1984 to 2014 and as a part-time professor at Lanzhou University.
